title: The Scaling Blunder: Chinchilla's Compute-Optimal Revolution

beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until The Scaling Blunder unlocks 67.5% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A massive, towering library structure with thousands of empty, dark shelves.

beats.text: The villain? Parameter bloat. We scaled model size to the moon while starving them of the training data they desperately needed.
beats.visual_focus: A scale balancing a giant weight (parameters) against a tiny, flickering candle (data).

beats.text: The pivot? Compute-optimal scaling. For every doubling of model parameters. You must double your training tokens. It is a perfect, rigid symmetry.
beats.visual_focus: A mathematical graph showing two lines rising in perfect parallel lockstep.
